mission: Recover every usable bot and system under original-bots, reconcile it against the canonical App_bots fleet, and expose truly missing original workers as supplemental Buddy-routable profiles without corrupting the verified 1,051 canonical baseline.
identity_rules: Normalize slug, display name, capabilities and source before comparison.
Exact normalized slug matches remain canonical and are not duplicated.
Strong normalized-name matches with different slugs become merge_review instead of duplicate workers.
Original bot-like records not represented in App_bots become supplemental_recovered workers.
Original system/code/config assets are retained in the recovery inventory even when they are not bot profiles.
Never delete original-bots source files during recovery.
truth_rule: Recovery proves source inventory and Buddy-routable shared sandbox profiles. It does not prove every recovered historical implementation still works; recovered workers must pass the same sandbox/runtime certification before production claims.
